terms.comment: Our formation: Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no word for an extension cord. Fūniculus ēlectricus is Traupman’s electric cord (p. 309); the adjective is made from the late verb prōlongāre, to lengthen (Lewis & Short), and is not itself in Lewis & Short.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 309.
